CLARIFICATION OF NEWS REPORT

THOUGH ITS NAME WAS MENTIONED IN THE ARTICLE, IT APPEARS THAT NONE OF THE COMPANY'S OFFICERS OR DIRECTORS WAS QUOTED TO HAVE MADE ANY OF THE STATEMENTS IN THE ARTICLE.SPECIFICALLY, AS TO THE PLANS OF COMBINING WITH PRIME WATER INFRASTRUCTURE, THIS IS A MATTER BETTER ADDRESSED BY THE PARTIES CONCERNED AS TO ANY PLANS, IF AT ALL, NAMELY PRIME WATER AND TUBIG PILIPINAS GROUP INC. ("TPGI"); AS TO THE COMPANY'S BUSINESS PLAN/STRATEGY IN RELATION TO THE ACQUISITION OF TPGI AS OF DATE, THE ONLY STEP BEING PROFFERED AT THE MOMENT IS THE PROPOSED SHARE-SWAP BETWEEN THE COMPANY AND ITS CURRENT CORPORATE SHAREHOLDERS, PURE WATER CORPORATION AND QUAD WATER CORPORATION, AND POTENTIALLY THE FOREIGN COMPONENT OF TPGI; AND AS TO IMPACT ON THE FINANCIAL CONDITION AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS OF THE COMPANY ("COAL"), NO RESULTS AS TO ANY PRELIMINARY EVALUATION CAN BE CITED AS OF THE MOMENT.
